one_liner_zh: Datadog 上季 EPS 0.59 美元超預期 6.33%，營收 9.53 億美元，成長動能延續但增速略趨穩。
one_liner_en: Datadog posted EPS of $0.59, beating by 6.33%, with revenue of $953.2M as momentum continued at a steady pace.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 超預期 6.33%，獲利穩健（營收年增率未提供）。
ai_view_zh: 訊號中性偏正：EPS 超預期幅度較前季收斂，顯示獲利穩健但成長加速度趨緩。短期財報無重大意外，股價反應料溫和。中期關鍵在於 AI 工作負載能否轉化為實質用量增長、以及高估值下能否持續以 GAAP 轉正改善獲利結構。追蹤指標包括客戶數、NRR 與毛利率走勢。
ai_view_en: Signal is mildly positive: the smaller EPS beat versus the prior quarter suggests solid profitability but moderating growth acceleration. Near term the print is unsurprising, implying a muted reaction. Mid term, the key is whether AI workloads convert into real usage growth and whether GAAP profitability keeps improving at this valuation. Track customer count, NRR and gross margin trends.
highlights_zh: EPS 0.59 美元，超預期 6.33%，連續維持獲利動能
營收 9.53 億美元，規模穩步擴大
可觀測性平台滲透率持續提升
AI 相關功能（如 LLM 觀測）成為新成長題材
highlights_en: EPS of $0.59 beat by 6.33%, continuing profitability momentum
Revenue of $953.2M with steady scale expansion
Ongoing penetration of the observability platform
AI-related features such as LLM observability emerge as growth driver
risks_zh: 本益比 609 倍，估值容錯空間有限
本期未提供營收年增率，成長能見度待確認
雲端用量計費對景氣循環敏感
risks_en: P/E of 609x leaves little room for error
Revenue YoY not provided, limiting growth visibility this period
Usage-based billing is sensitive to macro cycles
